calgary-tower.name: Calgary Tower
calgary-tower.price_text: Paid admission · check current price on the day
calgary-tower.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–22:00 · check on the day
calgary-tower.tip: Go up for the 360° view, then stand on the glass floor if you dare.

calaway-park.name: Calaway Park
calaway-park.price_text: Paid day pass · check current price on the day
calaway-park.hours: Seasonal, summer mainly · check on the day
calaway-park.tip: It is west of the city, so plan a full day and check the season dates first.

the-last-of-us.name: The Last of Us filming locations
the-last-of-us.price_text: Free to walk · paid tours vary
the-last-of-us.tip: The show was filmed around Alberta; check current fan maps before you go, as exact spots change.

stephen-ave.name: Stephen Avenue Walk
stephen-ave.tip: A pedestrian street of old sandstone buildings. Walk it at lunch for the food and buskers.

glenbow.name: Glenbow Museum
glenbow.price_text: Paid admission · check on the day
glenbow.hours: Closed some weekdays · check on the day
glenbow.tip: Good for western Canadian history and First Nations collections. Check opening days before you go.

princes-island.name: Prince's Island Park
princes-island.tip: Cross the bridge from Eau Claire and walk the river paths. Great picnic spot in summer.

peace-bridge.name: Peace Bridge
peace-bridge.tip: A red steel pedestrian bridge. Quick photo stop linking downtown to the north riverbank.

studio-bell.name: Studio Bell, home of the National Music Centre
studio-bell.price_text: Paid admission · check on the day
studio-bell.hours: Closed some days · check on the day
studio-bell.tip: Interactive music museum. You can play instruments and see Canadian music history.

central-library.name: Calgary Central Library
central-library.tip: Striking modern building with a big wooden atrium. Free to enter and warm up in winter.

kensington.name: Kensington neighbourhood walk
kensington.tip: Independent shops, cafes and patios. Walk here from the river or take a short ride.

inglewood.name: Inglewood stroll and 9th Avenue
inglewood.tip: Calgary's oldest neighbourhood. Good for indie shops, breweries and a slower pace.

fort-calgary.name: Fort Calgary
fort-calgary.price_text: Paid admission · check on the day
fort-calgary.tip: Where the city began. Pair it with a walk through Inglewood next door.

calgary-farmers-market.name: Calgary Farmers' Market
calgary-farmers-market.tip: Local produce, baking and food stalls. Good for a casual lunch.

calgary-zoo.name: Calgary Zoo
calgary-zoo.price_text: Paid admission · check on the day
calgary-zoo.tip: Big zoo with a dinosaur park. Allow half a day and wear comfy shoes.

heritage-park.name: Heritage Park Historical Village
heritage-park.price_text: Paid admission · check on the day
heritage-park.tip: Living history village with a steam train and old rides. Check season dates first.

scotsman-hill.name: Scotsman's Hill viewpoint
scotsman-hill.tip: Best free skyline view of downtown and the Calgary Tower. Go at sunset.

stampede-park.name: Stampede Park
stampede-park.tip: Home of the Calgary Stampede in July. Check what is on during your dates.

bow-river-path.name: Bow River pathway walk
bow-river-path.tip: Long paved riverside trail. Rent a bike or just walk a stretch near downtown.

devonian-gardens.name: Devonian Gardens
devonian-gardens.hours: Mall hours · check on the day
devonian-gardens.tip: Indoor garden inside a downtown mall. A warm break on a cold day.

beltline-food-walk.name: 17th Avenue Beltline food walk
beltline-food-walk.tip: Busy strip of restaurants and bars. Walk it in the evening and pick a patio.

olympic-plaza.name: Olympic Plaza
olympic-plaza.tip: Central square that becomes an outdoor ice rink in winter. Check skate rental on the day.
olympic-plaza.best: Winter for skating, summer for events
